name: SpeakEasy
tagline: AR glasses that see the surroundings and offer nonverbal users phrases to speak aloud.
problem: Assistive communication tools are bulky and pull users' eyes away from the people they talk with.
solution: Object detection on smart glasses generates context-aware phrase suggestions on an interactive display and speaks the chosen one instantly.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at a coffee cup and pick a suggested phrase to order.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Keeps the user facing the person they are talking to.

lessons: Fast inference matters when a person is waiting mid-conversation.
